official_route_steps.query: MATCH (r:ROUTE {dataset:$dataset,id:'JZG-OFF-01-R-5489d330c8'})-[:HAS_STEP]->(s:ROUTE_STEP) OPTIONAL MATCH (s)-[:VISITS]->(p:POI) RETURN s.index AS step_index,s.id AS step_id,collect(p.name) AS pois ORDER BY step_index

commute.query: MATCH (l:TRANSPORT_LEG {dataset:$dataset})-[:FROM]->(a:POI {name:'成都天府机场'}) MATCH (l)-[:TO]->(b:POI) OPTIONAL MATCH (l)-[:HAS_FACT]->(f:FACT) RETURN l.id AS leg_id,a.name AS origin,b.name AS destination,collect([f.attribute,f.value_text]) AS facts ORDER BY leg_id

node_types.query: MATCH (n:P5Node {dataset:$dataset}) UNWIND [l IN labels(n) WHERE l <> 'P5Node'] AS label RETURN label,count(n) AS count ORDER BY label

edge_types.query: MATCH ()-[r]->() WHERE r.dataset=$dataset RETURN type(r) AS type,count(r) AS count ORDER BY type

advice_summaries.query: MATCH (s:ADVICE_SUMMARY {dataset:$dataset}) RETURN count(s) AS total,sum(CASE WHEN s.scope_status IS NULL AND s.target_id IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS default_targeted,sum(CASE WHEN s.scope_status IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS quarantined,sum(CASE WHEN s.scope_status IS NULL AND s.target_id IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS unlocated

entity_themes.query: MATCH (n:P5Node {dataset:$dataset}) WHERE n.advice_themes_json IS NOT NULL RETURN count(n) AS entities_with_themes
